mergedParams.userDescription: Text deconstructed into particles that swarm and reassemble. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: Particle Swarm Typography - Text Deconstructs & Reassembles

prompts.prompt: Create a typokinetics preset where text explodes into hundreds of small particle elements that scatter chaotically before magnetically reassembling into the original text. Think of it like a controlled explosion in After Effects where each letter breaks into 20-30 div particles that fly outward with physics-based motion, then reverse their trajectories to reform. Use a staggered animation approach where each word explodes sequentially with a 100-200ms offset. The particles should have varying sizes (scale 0.1 to 0.3 of original), random rotation during flight, and subtle motion blur. During reassembly, particles should accelerate as they approach their target positions, creating a magnetic attraction effect. Consider this as editing multiple particle layers in premiere with different timing offsets and turbulence effects.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with 'relative overflow-hidden' containing individual word BaseLayouts. Each word spawns 20-30 child BaseLayouts as particles using repeatChildrenProps with 'absolute' positioning. Use TextAtom for the base text with opacity:0 after explosion. Particles use 'w-1 h-1 bg-current rounded-full' with transform effects. Animation: Create internal effect preset 'particle-explosion' with 3 phases - stable (0-20%), explosion (20-60%), reassembly (60-100%). Use generic effects with translateX/Y randomized -200 to 200px, rotate randomized 0-720deg, scale from 1 to random(0.1-0.3) to 1, opacity 1-0.8-1. Apply 'ease-out' for explosion, 'ease-in-out' with slight overshoot for reassembly. Use blur effect (0-2-0px) for motion blur. Timing: Total duration 2-3s per word, stagger words by 150ms using relative timing. Performance: Use 'will-change-transform' on particles, limit to 30 particles per word max, use transform3d for GPU acceleration.

prompts.prompt: Design a typokinetics preset inspired by magnetic field visualizations where text characters dissolve into iron filing-like particles that flow along invisible force field lines before coalescing back into readable text. Picture editing a sequence where you're animating particles along bezier paths in After Effects, with each particle following slightly different curved trajectories. The particles should move in smooth arcs and spirals, clustering and separating based on simulated magnetic forces. Include a subtle glow effect on particles as they move, intensifying when they cluster together. This creates a sci-fi holographic reconstruction effect perfect for futuristic titles.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'flex flex-wrap gap-2' for word spacing. Each word uses BaseLayout 'relative inline-block' containing TextAtom (original text, opacity transitioning 1-0-1) and particle container BaseLayout. Generate 15-20 particles per character using nested BaseLayouts with 'absolute inset-0'. Particles use 'w-0.5 h-2 bg-gradient-to-b from-current to-transparent rounded-full'. Animation: Create custom bezier path animations using translateX/Y with multiple keyframes (0%, 15%, 35%, 65%, 85%, 100%) to simulate curved magnetic field lines. Add rotate effect following tangent of path (calculated from translate deltas). Scale particles 0-1-0.3-1 with 'ease-in-out'. Add glow using filter 'drop-shadow(0 0 3px currentColor)' intensifying at cluster points (35% and 65%). Timing: 3-4s total duration, use fitDurationTo:'self' with minimum 3s. Stagger character animations by 50ms for wave effect. Performance: Batch particle updates using single requestAnimationFrame, use CSS containment 'contain-paint', limit glow effects to every 3rd particle.

prompts.prompt: Build a glitch-style typokinetics preset where text shatters into digital fragments that corrupt and reorganize through datamoshing-inspired transitions. Imagine cutting between multiple text layers in Premiere with displacement maps and chromatic aberration. Text should break into rectangular segments of varying sizes (like corrupted video blocks), shift with digital noise patterns, experience color channel separation (RGB split), then snap back together with a digital reconstruction effect. Add scan lines and interference patterns during the corruption phase for authentic digital distortion.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout 'relative' with 3 duplicate TextAtom layers for RGB channels using 'absolute inset-0' positioning. Fragment using grid of BaseLayout divs with 'overflow-hidden' containing masked portions of text via clip-path rectangles. Create 8-12 fragments per word with varying sizes (w-4 h-2, w-6 h-3, w-8 h-1). Animation: Phase 1 (0-30%): Apply translateX offset to RGB layers (-2px red, 0px green, +2px blue) with opacity 0.7 each. Phase 2 (30-70%): Fragments translate randomly X(-50,50)px Y(-30,30)px with stepped easing (steps(4)) for digital feel. Add brightness(1.5) and contrast(1.2) filters. Rotate some fragments 90deg suddenly. Phase 3 (70-100%): Snap back with 'cubic-bezier(0.68,-0.55,0.265,1.55)' for slight bounce. Effects: Add scan line overlay using repeating linear-gradient background, animate opacity 0.1-0.3. Timing: 1.5-2s duration, can sync to audio beats if available using waveform effects.

prompts.prompt: Create an organic typokinetics preset where text dissolves into liquid-like particles that flow and morph like ferrofluid before reforming. Think of compositing fluid simulation renders where particles have cohesion and viscosity. Text should melt into flowing droplets that maintain loose connections, stretch and contract like elastic strings, then surface tension pulls them back together. Use metaball-like visual cohesion where nearby particles blend together. This creates a premium liquid metal or mercury effect ideal for luxury brand titles.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative preserve-3d' for depth. Each character becomes 10-15 circular particles using BaseLayout 'absolute rounded-full bg-current'. Vary sizes 'w-2 h-2' to 'w-4 h-4'. Add connecting elements between nearby particles using SVG lines or elongated divs with 'absolute bg-current' and dynamic width/rotation. Animation: Use spring physics easing 'cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275)' for organic motion. Particles translateX/Y with interconnected timing - when one moves, nearby particles follow with 50ms delay and 70% of distance. Scale particles 1-1.3-0.8-1 to simulate surface tension. Apply filter 'blur(0.5px)' during motion, clear when static. For cohesion effect, detect proximity and scale up overlapping particles 10%, add 'mix-blend-mode-screen'. Timing: 2.5-3s duration, smooth continuous motion without hard stops. Performance: Use transform3d, update particle positions in batches, cache distance calculations between particles.

prompts.prompt: Develop a crystallization typokinetics preset where text fragments into geometric shards that tumble through 3D space before reassembling like a reverse-shatter effect. Envision editing a sequence where you're animating individual polygonal pieces with different rotation axes, like shattered glass reforming in reverse. Each character breaks into 5-8 triangular/polygonal shapes using clip-path, tumbling with perspective transforms. Add refraction effects with color shifts and light rays passing through the shards. Perfect for dramatic title reveals with impact.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout 'relative perspective-1000' for 3D space. Each character uses multiple BaseLayout fragments with TextAtom clipped via 'clip-path: polygon()' creating triangular shards. Define 5-8 unique polygon shapes per character. Overlay fragments use 'absolute inset-0' positioning. Animation: Apply transform: rotateX/Y/Z with different axes per shard (X: -180 to 180deg, Y: -90 to 90deg, Z: -45 to 45deg). Translate shards outward translateZ(-100 to -300px) then back. Use 'ease-in-out' for realistic physics. Add brightness and hue-rotate filters to simulate light refraction: 'filter: brightness(1.2) hue-rotate(10deg)' varying per shard. Create light ray effects using gradient overlays with 'mix-blend-mode-overlay'. Timing: 2-2.5s duration, stagger shard animations by 30-50ms for cascading effect. Performance: Limit to 8 shards per character, use transform3d for GPU, batch filter applications.

prompts.prompt: Design a swarm intelligence typokinetics preset where text atomizes into autonomous particles that exhibit flocking behavior before converging back into formation. Think of animating a murmuration of starlings in After Effects where particles follow boid algorithm principles - separation, alignment, and cohesion. Particles should move as a collective swarm with emergent patterns, creating mesmerizing flows and formations before gradually organizing back into readable text. Include subtle trails and motion echoes for enhanced visual flow.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container 'relative w-full h-full' with particle system BaseLayout 'absolute inset-0'. Generate 100-150 small particles (BaseLayout 'absolute w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-current opacity-60') distributed across text boundaries. Store particle positions and velocities in component state. Animation: Implement simplified boid behavior using generic effects with custom keyframes. Each particle calculates translateX/Y based on: 1) Separation - avoid nearby particles within 20px, 2) Alignment - match average direction of neighbors within 50px, 3) Cohesion - move toward center of nearby group. Add slight randomness (±5px) for organic motion. Create trailing effect using 3-5 ghost particles per main particle with decreasing opacity (0.4, 0.2, 0.1) and 50ms position delay. Convergence phase: gradually increase cohesion force and target original text positions. Timing: 3-4s total, first 40% free swarm, 40-80% convergence, final 20% settle. Performance: Update positions every 60fps using requestAnimationFrame, use transform3d, spatial hashing for neighbor detection.

prompts.prompt: Create a dimensional drift typokinetics preset where text breaks apart into layers that drift through parallax z-space before snapping back together. Picture editing multiple text duplicates on different video tracks with varying scales and blur amounts to create depth. Each word splits into 3-5 depth layers that drift apart in Z-space with different velocities, creating a parallax dispersion effect. Add chromatic aberration and depth-of-field blur to layers based on their Z position. This creates a cinematic depth-based dissolution perfect for film titles.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout 'relative preserve-3d perspective-800' containing word groups. Each word spawns 4 z-layers using BaseLayout 'absolute' with same TextAtom content. Assign z-index and translateZ values: near(100px, z-10), mid-near(50px, z-5), mid-far(-50px, z-3), far(-150px, z-1). Animation: Animate each layer's translateZ expanding outward: near to 200px, mid-near to 100px, mid-far to -100px, far to -300px. Add lateral drift with translateX/Y based on depth (far layers move more). Apply dynamic blur based on Z distance: 'filter: blur(0-4px)' for far layers. Add chromatic aberration to distant layers using RGB channel splits with transform: translateX(-1px to -3px for red, +1px to +3px for blue). Scale layers based on perspective (far = 0.8, near = 1.2). Timing: 2.5s duration, stagger layer animations by 100ms starting from furthest. Use 'cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)' for smooth depth transitions. Performance: Limit to 4 layers per word, use will-change: transform, filter.

prompts.prompt: Build a circuit-trace typokinetics preset where text decomposes into particles that travel along animated PCB-like pathways before reassembling at destination nodes. Imagine creating animated tech overlays where particles follow specific circuit routes with right-angle turns and junction splits. Particles should emit a glow trail as they travel, pause at connection nodes, then accelerate through traces. Include electrical spark effects at junction points and a final assembly surge. Perfect for tech/cyber themed content.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout 'relative bg-gray-900' with SVG pathway overlay defining circuit traces using <path> elements. Text particles (15-20 per word) as BaseLayout 'absolute w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-cyan-400' with 'box-shadow: 0 0 10px currentColor'. Create junction nodes at path intersections using BaseLayout 'absolute w-4 h-4 rounded-full border-2 border-cyan-400'. Animation: Particles follow SVG paths using calculated translateX/Y positions along path.getTotalLength(). Move in steps with brief pauses (100ms) at nodes. Speed varies: slow at turns (0.5x), fast on straight sections (1.5x). Add pulse effect at nodes: scale(1-1.5-1) with brightness(1-2-1). Create trail effect using ::after pseudo-element with 'absolute inset-0 bg-current opacity-0.3' and translation delay. Spark effects at junctions using quick opacity flash (0-1-0 in 100ms) with scale burst. Final assembly includes convergence to text position with 'ease-out' and electric surge effect (brightness flash). Timing: 3-3.5s total, particles staggered by 50ms, node pauses 100ms each. Performance: Pre-calculate path positions, use CSS animations for trails, batch particle updates.

prompts.prompt: Develop a vortex typokinetics preset where text particles spiral into a central whirlpool before being ejected and reorganized back into readable form. Think of creating a black hole effect in After Effects where particles follow logarithmic spiral paths with increasing velocity as they approach the center. Text breaks into particles that get caught in a rotating vortex, spin faster as they spiral inward, disappear briefly at the singularity, then burst outward in reverse spiral to reform. Add stretching and warping effects near the vortex center for gravitational distortion.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout 'relative overflow-visible' with vortex center at 50% 50%. Text converts to 20-25 particles per word using BaseLayout 'absolute w-2 h-2'. Calculate initial positions based on character boundaries. Define spiral path using parametric equations: r = a * e^(b*θ) for logarithmic spiral. Animation: Phase 1 (0-40%): Particles begin orbiting with increasing angular velocity. Use transform: rotate(0-720deg) translateX(radius) where radius decreases exponentially. Add stretching near center using scaleX(1-2) scaleY(1-0.5) based on distance. Phase 2 (40-50%): Particles reach singularity, scale(0) opacity(0). Phase 3 (50-100%): Reverse burst, particles emerge with random angles, decelerate outward following inverse spiral to text positions. Add motion blur using filter: blur(0-3-0px) based on velocity. Warping effect using skewX/Y near vortex. Timing: 3s duration, particles staggered entry by 30ms based on distance from center. Use 'ease-in' approaching center, 'ease-out' ejecting. Performance: Pre-calculate spiral coordinates, use transform3d, CSS contain: layout.

prompts.prompt: Create a quantum superposition typokinetics preset where text exists in multiple probability states simultaneously before collapsing into a single reality. Visualize editing multiple semi-transparent text layers that phase in and out of existence with different positions and states. Each character spawns 3-5 'probability ghosts' that flicker between states, vibrate with quantum uncertainty, then collapse through a wave function into the final text. Add interference patterns where probability waves overlap and scanning measurement lines that trigger the collapse.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout 'relative' containing original TextAtom at base layer. Generate 4 probability states per character using BaseLayout 'absolute inset-0' with TextAtom duplicates. Each state has unique transform offset: translateX(-10 to 10px) translateY(-5 to 5px) rotate(-5 to 5deg). Animation: Phase 1 (0-60%): Probability states flicker using opacity keyframes [0.2, 0.6, 0.3, 0.5, 0.4] on 200ms loops with different offsets per state. Add micro-vibration using translateX/Y(±2px) at 50ms intervals for quantum jitter. States phase shift using hue-rotate(0-30deg) animation. Phase 2 (60-80%): Measurement scan line (BaseLayout 'absolute h-full w-1 bg-cyan-400 opacity-0.5') sweeps across with translateX(0-100%). States begin converging as scan passes. Phase 3 (80-100%): Collapse animation - all states rapidly converge to base position with opacity fading to 0 except final state. Add brief brightness(2) flash at collapse moment. Interference patterns using mix-blend-mode: screen where states overlap. Timing: 2.5-3s duration, scan at 1s mark, collapse triggered by scan position. Performance: Limit to 4 states per character, use will-change: opacity, transform.
